title: DESY Summer Student Programme 2027
field: Physics, related natural sciences and computing
about: DESY summer research programme for advanced students in physics, related sciences and computing. The 2027 timeline lists online applications from early December to 31 January; the programme is expected to start 21 July 2027.
requirements: At least three years of university study in physics, related natural sciences or computing
Enrolled at a university for the whole period of the programme
Separate reserved-place track for students at Ukrainian universities (until 15 February)
card_alt: Card for the DESY Summer Student Programme 2027 at Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESY, Germany, with an application deadline of 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows Cologne Cathedral and the illuminated Hohenzollern Bridge at night under a starry sky, as a general image of Germany.
